title: Margin Management

edits.reason: The lesson intro explicitly teaches the original target as a concrete, locatable level: 'Real trade: Entry $134.83 | Stop $124.95 | Original Target $160 | R = 2.55' and 'Price blew through original target'. The chart draws Entry (80), Stop (76), the revised Target $282 (120) and Exit (114) but never shows the $160 level that price blew through — leaving the R=2.55 -> 14.9x re-plan story untethered to the chart. Scaling Entry $134.83->80 and Target $282->120 (linear, ~0.272 chart units per $1), $160 maps to 80 + (160-134.83)/(282-134.83)*40 = ~86.8 -> yAxis 87, which sits inside the visible band (~76-121) between entry and the live target. Color gold #ffcc00: this chapter already uses gold for the funding-cost Exit; gold is the palette's take-profit/target color, and using it (not the live teal Target) visually distinguishes the superseded original target from the active $282 target rather than duplicating it.
